card.name: Start of drug names beginning with N
card.fires_on: The lone letter N or n that begins a drug or drug-class name (niacin, nisoldipine, nitrates, nucleoside, nifedipine, norethandrolone), usually right after a period, comma or 'or' in interaction lists.

modes.label: Capital N after a period
modes.description: Capital N opens a new interaction entry or heading such as Niacin or Nucleoside.

modes.label: Lowercase n in a drug list
modes.description: Lowercase n starts a drug name that follows a comma or 'or' in a list of drugs.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated word beginnings, mainly Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on the single letter N that starts a drug name like niacin or nitrates in interaction lists.
